programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: [AD] The sleuth investigates the murder of a Colonial Postal Service officer when the fair comes to Kembleford. Drama, starring Mark Williams and Sorcha Cusack

programme.title: The Good Life
programme.desc: [AD] Barbara's last posh frock gets torn, plunging her into gloom - and Tom thoughtlessly makes matters worse by fawning over an elegantly dressed dinner guest. Self-sufficiency comedy, starring Felicity Kendal and Richard Briers

programme.title: Harry Enfield's Television Programme
programme.desc: Harry Enfield's established comedy favourites, including forgetful pub landlord Les Norris, DJ dinosaurs Smashie 'n' Nicey and Wayne and Waynetta Slob, drowning in pizza boxes

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Russell Howard uses ear wax to charm a nice lady called Carol, Asim Chaudhry goes digging for invertebrates and Liza Tarbuck makes a puzzle for children

programme.title: The Ricky Gervais Show
programme.desc: Karl Pilkington reflects on his trip to Gran Canaria and Ricky Gervais and Stephen Merchant join him in a discussion about childhood nicknames. Plus, another instalment of Monkey News

programme.title: Hacks
programme.desc: [AD] After Marty delivers a crushing blow, Deborah and Ava travel to a comedy club in Sacramento to try out her new material, which inadvertently sparks a career-defining moment for Deborah. Meanwhile, Ava finds herself stuck between her parents' competing interests, and Marcus takes a step forward with Wilson. Comedy drama, starring Jean Smart, Hannah Einbinder and Carl Clemons-Hopkins

programme.title: Germanwings: What Happened on Flight 9525?
programme.desc: The circumstances surrounding the crash of an Airbus A320-211 in 2015, which killed 150 people and was found to have been deliberately caused by the co-pilot

programme.title: Silent Witness
programme.desc: [AD] Part two of two. Nikki prepares to publicly concede she may have been wrong about Anna Holland's innocence, but Leo urges her not to throw her career away while there is still uncertainty. Harry tries to identify two bodies found buried in the garden of an empty house - and finds they are connected to his colleague's troubling case. Emilia Fox and Tom Ward star

programme.title: Baku: An Art Lovers' Guide
programme.desc: [AD] Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke explore the capital of Azerbaijan, which offers a mix of the ancient and modern in a country where cultural life is tightly controlled

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: [AD] A disturbance in Stan's daily bedtime routine unleashes his alter-ego, a do-gooder intent on completing all the heroic deeds he would never normally even contemplate. Animated comedy, with the voice of Seth MacFarlane

programme.title: A Touch of Frost
programme.desc: [AD] The naked bodies of three men are found placed in the shape of a triangle, leading Jack to suspect the work of a satanic cult. Meanwhile, press baron James Callum's plans to make his mark on Denton are hindered by an investigation into his lover's death in a houseboat fire - and the suspicious demise of his former girlfriend may be the key to unmasking the killer. Starring David Jason, Bruce Alexander, Adrian Lukis, Sarah Matravers and Paul Shane

programme.title: Benidorm
programme.desc: [AD] Mick is horrified when his dim-witted brother Pete arrives for his stag night with their dad Stan in tow, while Gavin thinks Troy has broken up with him and agrees to a date with Emilio. programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: [AD] Liz explores the natural wonders of the region and its remarkable ecosystems, encountering its wildlife and meeting inspiring local conservationists. She begins in the Greater Antilles, where people are learning to forge a new relationship with the animals that inhabit this wild terrain. On the island of Hispaniola in the Dominican Republic, she helps residents of the tiny village of Los Limones scale a 60ft palm tree to retrieve a Ridgeway's hawk chick at risk of a deadly parasitic infection

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team travel to Sydney, Australia, to value artefacts and rarities on the other side of the world. Among items brought in are part of the keel of Captain Cook's ship Endeavour, furniture made by convicts transported to the country during the 18th century, and a collection of opera star Maria Callas memorabilia - which receives one of the highest valuations ever given on the programme

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: [AD] Michael Portillo heads from Newcastle to Lynemouth, and is intrigued to hear of its part in Newcastle's early industrial development. En route, Michael travels through the huge Northumberland coalfield and, at Cramlington, he alights to visit an extraordinary work of landform art made from the spoil of a coalmine, the vast Northumberlandia, known as the Lady of the North

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: [AD] David Dickinson and the experts visit Wolverhampton, where Simon Schneider gets all tongue-tied over a Scottish drinking vessel and Tony Geering hears a tale about a miner's lamp

programme.title: Lingo
programme.desc: Quiz hosted by Adil Ray, with sisters Sangeeta and Namita from Bolton, mother and son Gill and Matt from Liverpool, and punctuation purist Priya and fiancé Priyesh from London. They use their powers of deduction to work out words that appear in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords. The last remaining duo have the opportunity to win the money they've banked earlier in the show to potentially double their winnings, or leave with nothing

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team search for valuable finds in Ashridge House, Hertfordshire, joined by antiqus experts Claire Rawle and Thomas Plant, who set their sights on a Susie Cooper charger and a Royal Worcester coffee set. Paul also explores the history of the venue and discovers a colourful past filled with illustrious lodgers, including Queen Elizabeth I

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as contestants Gill, Neil, Vicky and Matt pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Mum and daughter Mandy and Elly host the week's second visit at Devon Heaven Hideaways, where they offer a touch of bliss at their plush glampsite. First impressions are excellent, everyone enjoys a trip to a castle, and a riverside breakfast is a roaring success. So why do the hosts end up shocked by their scores?

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The second host in and around Belfast, writer and illustrator Kate, plans to take her guests on a taste adventure with some locally sourced, home-grown and foraged food. She's hoping to impress her guests with fashion and festival vibes, and a splash of semi-nudity thrown in for good measure. After a friendly floral arrival and some thrifty fashion tips, there's frivolous artwork and a flashing admission, before Kate's night ends with a mini festival on the lawn. Will her guests be feeling the vibes or dishing out jibes?

programme.title: 5 News with Dan Walker
programme.desc: National and international news

programme.title: The Office (US)
programme.desc: Michael has to come up with a cheaper company health plan, so decides to pass the job on to Dwight. Delighted with his new-found responsibility, he commandeers the conference room as his 'office' and proceeds to offend all his co-workers by asking them to divulge their medical histories

programme.title: The Office (US)
programme.desc: Michael makes a ludicrous attempt to raise team morale in the office, by arranging a birthday party for Meredith a month in advance, and trying to think up a witty message to write in her card. Meanwhile, Dwight and Jim grow scared of being ousted amid rumours of employee cutbacks, and agree to look out for one another

programme.title: Nothing to Declare
programme.desc: Another edition of the fly-on-the-wall documentary accessing the world of national security at Australia's biggest airports, following customs and immigration officers as they go about their daily business of tackling drug runners, illegal immigrants and terrorists

programme.title: Nothing to Declare
programme.desc: Another edition of the fly-on-the-wall documentary accessing the world of national security at Australia's biggest airports, following customs and immigration officers as they go about their daily business of tackling drug runners, illegal immigrants and terrorists

programme.title: Task
programme.desc: [AD] As he prepares for an emotional court appearance, Tom buries himself in the case, while Emily questions her obligations to the family. Maeve makes a critical choice to protect her own loved ones, while Robbie works to find a way to turn his newfound surplus into cash

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: [AD] When a prestigious chess match ends in murder, the team members have to work out how and why the killing was carried out. Meanwhile, the Commissioner is confronted with his past by the very last person he was expecting to see. Caribbean-set detective drama, starring Ralf Little, Don Warrington and Tahj Miles

programme.title: Are You Being Served?
programme.desc: Mr Goldberg sets up an employment agency and tries to find new jobs for Mrs Slocombe and Mr Humphries. Classic comedy, starring Alfie Bass, Mollie Sugden and John Inman

programme.title: Are You Being Served?
programme.desc: Young Mr Grace discusses marriage plans with Mrs Slocombe - and the staff are quick to grab the wrong end of the stick. Shop floor comedy, starring Mollie Sugden, John Inman and Harold Bennett

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: As the chef's Cornish odyssey nears its end, he takes a break in the city of Truro, where he discovers an unusual ghost story and tours the magnificent cathedral. He also meets a family passionate about offal, who prepare Rick a meal of pickled ox tongue and beef heart tacos, and in the county's most northerly parish he tells the story of an eccentric vicar who would retrieve the bodies from nearby shipwrecks and bury them in his church graveyard

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: The chef champions the food, history, music, art and culture of the county, beginning by reflecting on his early days running a nightclub in Padstow. He goes for a bracing dip in Bude's sea pool, while in Sennen Cove off Land's End, Rick braves the notoriously wild Atlantic waters to learn about the ancient fishing method of handlining

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with the Soap Opera Party
programme.desc: [AD] Joey throws a party for the cast of Days of Our Lives, but refuses to invite his pals in case their behaviour embarrasses him. However, the answering machine gives the game away and everyone attends - which is good news for Ross

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with the Fertility Test
programme.desc: [AD] Chandler and Monica go to a fertility clinic for tests, but are embarrassed to encounter an old acquaintance. Ross helps Joey pretend to be intelligent to woo Charlie, even though he is attracted to her himself, and Rachel sneaks into a spa for a massage

programme.title: Community
programme.desc: Part two of two. Troy and Abed's rivalry over their pillow forts escalates into all-out war, and their friends are forced to choose sides

programme.title: Community
programme.desc: Britta asks the others to keep her away from her ex-boyfriend, who has come to town with a travelling carnival. Laybourne involves Dean Pelton in his ongoing schemes

programme.title: Discovering: Richard Gere
programme.desc: [AD] A look at the life and career of the American actor, who starred in Days of Heaven, American Gigolo, An Officer and a Gentleman, Pretty Woman and Chicago

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island
programme.desc: Part one of two. The women of Rhode Island sit down with Andy Cohen to discuss their very first season and dive deeper into their personal relationships.

programme.title: Classic Coronation Street
programme.desc: [AD] Joe's actions reveal to Gail the scale of his addiction after she responds to the medical centre alarm. Kevin gets tough with Chesney, and Jason and Tina buy No 12 at the auction.

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: [AD] Joe risks his career to help Dawson when she is accused of theft following a raid on local crook Frank Batley's home and £400 goes missing. Bernie faces a tough decision when he learns he has a daughter he never knew existed. Starring Joe McFadden and Peter Benson

programme.title: Minder
programme.desc: [AD] Arthur purchases a consignment of satellite dishes, enlisting the aid of a former television repair man to fit them. However, his contractor proves to be afraid of heights. Meanwhile, Ray develops an interest in the daughter of volatile Italian businessman 'Fingers' Rosetti. Pete Postlethwaite guest stars, with George Cole and Gary Webster

programme.title: Forensics: Catching the Killer
programme.desc: [AD] Police use forensic evidence to catch the perpetrator who murdered a mother in her home in 1994

programme.title: Landscape Artist of the Year 2018
programme.desc: Cameras follows the winner of the competition to Greece and Macedonia as they create an artwork to mark the centenary of the end of the First World War

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.sub-title: Goat Tell It on the Mountain
programme.desc: The buyers head out to Lake Arrowhead, California, where Ivy puts economies of scale to the test. Justin almost hits the bull's-eye on his locker, while Darrell and Chad find fortunes on the farm

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Dave brings his mentor with him to Rancho Cucamonga, but has little to show for it. Brandi and Jarrod go all in on a hunch, Kenny tries to downsize his strategy, while Ivy shows a skeptical Emily how he pulls a win out of a locker

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: A 13-year-old leopard that has dominated two square miles of territory for years faces a challenge from a younger, stronger rival

programme.title: Alaska: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: The Raneys put their ingenuity to the test on a homestead in Hawaii that was destroyed by lava. They need to find a way of protecting it from future eruptions.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Phoebe is trapped in the underworld when she switches bodies with a power-hungry sorceress, who uses her face to gain influence over Zankou. Paige has difficulty looking after new Whitelighter Mitchell, who is troubled by his calling and shows little interest in learning the ways of the Elders. Supernatural drama, starring Alyssa Milano

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina is devastated when she receives her first C for a class assignment, but her grades start to improve when Zelda gets romantically involved with her professor

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina opts to spend a picture-perfect Christmas with Morgan and her family rather than endure the annual insanity with Hilda and Zelda - but soon discovers that even mortals have problems. Melissa Joan Hart stars

programme.title: Call the Bailiffs: Time to Pay Up
programme.desc: [AD] Agents Mark and Sam pursue a company ordered by an employment tribunal to repay money unlawfully deducted from a former employee's wages. programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: [AD] Jo Rogers' team faces equipment trouble in the extreme cold, while Bjorn rescues a stranded car and Thord clashes with a truck driver

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: [AD] Stephen Mulhern hosts as contestant Dori tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: Nick Knowles meets midwife and kidney patient Sascha, who has to undergo intense dialysis sessions for hours on end, five days a week. Determined to help, the DIY SOS team, bolstered by the local tradespeople and volunteers of Welwyn Garden City, renovate her home to include a dedicated dialysis room, offering her the chance of many more years with her family
